verdict.rationale: No evidence shows an in-browser interactive API reference or a 'try it' console. Adjacent pieces do exist: a public OpenAPI spec repo with a runnable test project that generates a client library (gh-1), a free unlimited Test Drive sandbox with test personas for executing calls (docs-24, docs-25), and the MCP agent toolkit's dynamic generation of working code examples (docs-12). Together these give runnable examples, but only through extra tooling. Missing for 10: a documented interactive API explorer or try-it console, runnable examples embedded in the reference pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
